args.new_string:
"""Text helpers shared by the API layer."""

import re

_PUNCT = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")


def slugify(value, max_length=40):
    """Turn a title into a URL slug."""
    slug = _PUNCT.sub("-", value.strip().lower()).strip("-")
    return slug[:max_length]

from src.util.text import slugify

def test_slugify_lowercases():
    assert slugify("Hello World") == "hello-world"

def test_slugify_strips_punctuation():
    assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"

def test_slugify_max_length():
    # Test default max_length of 40
    long_title = "a" * 50
    assert slugify(long_title) == "a" * 40
    
    # Test custom max_length
    assert slugify("Hello World", max_length=5) == "hello"
    
    # Test with feed-like short length
    assert slugify("Hello World", max_length=20) == "hello-world"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_slugify_lowercases()
    test_slugify_strips_punctuation()
    test_slugify_max_length()
    print("All tests passed!")
